items.title: Deadline Alert: Baidu, Inc. (BIDU) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
items.summary: A class action securities fraud lawsuit has been filed against Baidu, Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements about its AI business growth and failing to disclose that its legacy online marketing business was declining faster than the AI segment could offset. The stock fell 5.65% on February 26, 2026 and 12.73% on August 18, 2026 following disappointing earnings reports. Investors who purchased Baidu securities between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026 have until November 13, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

items.title: רוזן, עו"ד מהימן למשקיעים, מעודד את משקיעי Baidu, Inc. לשכור ייצוג משפטי לקראת מועד חשוב בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות הערך – BIDU
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action securities lawsuit on behalf of Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIDU) investors who purchased securities between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Baidu made false or misleading statements regarding its AI capabilities and overstated its ability to offset declines in its traditional online marketing business, resulting in material misrepresentations about the company's business prospects. Investors who purchased Baidu securities during the class period may be eligible for compensation.

items.title: BIDU Class Action Reminder: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Baidu, Inc. Class Action Lawsuit
items.summary: Robbins LLP announced a class action lawsuit against Baidu, Inc. for allegedly overstating its AI business's ability to offset declines in its legacy online marketing business. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased BIDU securities between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026. Baidu's stock fell significantly after reporting disappointing financial results in February and August 2026, with the AI-powered business showing deceleration in growth. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 13, 2026.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT Bernstein Liebhard LLP Announces A Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Baidu, Inc. (BIDU)
items.summary: Bernstein Liebhard LLP has filed securities fraud class action lawsuits against Baidu, Inc., AST SpaceMobile, Inc., and Lincoln Educational Services Corporation. The lawsuits allege that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, causing investors to suffer significant losses when the truth was disclosed.

items.title: ROSEN, A LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Baidu, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BIDU
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Baidu, Inc., The Simply Good Foods Company, and FuelCell Energy, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities during specified class periods. The Baidu lawsuit alleges the company made false statements about its AI business's ability to offset declines in its legacy online marketing business, leading to overstated revenue projections. Investors who purchased during the class periods may be eligible for compensation.
